summary: Zhongchao Inc. (NASDAQ: ZCMD) furnished a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, providing proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting the US equivalent of an EGM on September 18, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET at Robinson Cole LLP, New York. Shareholders will consider two proposals: a two-for-one share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, each $0.744 par value, into $1.488 par value shares effective ten calendar days after passing, with fractional shares rounded up; and a subsequent capital reduction and reorganization lowering par value to $0.00001. No buyback, tender, or deal terms are stated; this is a routine corporate-action meeting notice, not a special situation.
